user.title: T-Pitwall
user.description: Address of the T-Pitwall dashboard, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8090. Token = TPitwall__Web__Token from .env – or, if you didn't set one, the token T-Pitwall made (docker compose exec t-pitwall cat /data/web-token).

reauth_confirm.title: New token
reauth_confirm.description: T-Pitwall rejected the token. Enter TPitwall__Web__Token from .env, or the one in T-Pitwall's /data/web-token.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach T-Pitwall. Check the address and that the dashboard is enabled (TPitwall__Web__Enabled).

abort.already_configured: This T-Pitwall is already set up.

bridge_too_old.title: T-Pitwall needs an update
bridge_too_old.description: T-Pitwall runs version {installed}, but this integration needs at least {required}. Update the container on the server, in T-Pitwall's folder: `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d`.
